title: Let the Mac session run AWS, CDK and GitHub commands without safety-checker refusals
description:
Remote Control sessions on Ryan's Mac (folder ~/Projects/Chattic.us) keep refusing aws, cdk and gh commands through their safety checker even though the AWS CLI profile chatticus-production is logged in. This stalled the staging rollout on 2026-10-19. Ryan cannot find or answer permission prompts in those sessions.

Done when: the Mac session's permission settings allow aws, cdk, gh, curl and infra/deploy-chatticus-account-deploy.sh (project .claude/settings.json or equivalent) so deploy briefs run end to end with no prompts. Do not suggest cloud AWS keys; security controls forbid them.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Obsolete: deploy and CDK/GitHub commands now run from the current desktop session, so the Remote Control permission fix is no longer needed. Reparented under the environments epic to satisfy the hierarchy and closed.
